title: Chapter 290: Finished The Night Snack
content:
Chapter 290: Finished The Night Snack

"Wenxi, do you think this is feasible?"

"Boss, this matter is of great importance. I wanted to report it to you when you were free, but things have been uneasy recently, so I haven't had time to tell you."

"Wenxi, you can handle this matter!"

"In the territory, those who need to move should move, and those who need to be demolished should be demolished."

"Okay, boss."

Afterwards, Wang Shuo went to the grocery store, the clinic and other places to inspect.

In the evening, Good returned to the camp.

"Lord, I have found out that there are about 800 of them in a valley 30 miles to the west."

"Okay, then we will set off immediately and try to come back early for a midnight snack."

For the flaming horse and the three-headed dog, the distance of 30 miles is only more than ten minutes at full speed.

With Wang Shuo's investment regardless of cost, the number of flaming horses in the territory has been considerable.

This kind of expansion is geometrically increasing. It is the slowest at the beginning. When the scale is reached, the speed will take off.

During this period, foreign merchants have been coming to trade. One of the birth-inducing pills can accelerate the birth of animals very quickly. The side effect is that the consumption of energy crystals is very huge.

The speed of the flaming warhorse is more than twice that of ordinary warhorses. No matter how much the cost is, it is worth it.

Therefore, there are more than 1,500 flaming warhorses at present.

All the golden fire cavalrymen rode on flaming horses, and half of the archers were equipped with this good horse.

"Let's go."

Wang Shuo gave an order and galloped out of the city with the main combat force of the territory and 2,500 red flame soldiers.

The afterglow of the setting sun fell!

Through the faint death aura that loomed, a dreamy scene was created in the valley.

Yoshida Mondo was very uncomfortable at this time.

On this trip, they originally wanted to come to Wana Town to buy dead spirit beads.

The dead spirit beads they bought from other middlemen were already full of dead energy. Several of his men had been infected with dead energy and turned into undead. Of course, these people were killed immediately.

At this time, they noticed a team of 100 people without any dead energy.

So they wanted to rob other people's dead spirit beads.

Their usual style is that what's mine is mine, and what's others can also be mine.

So they ruthlessly attacked the team of 100 people.

At this time, one of his confidants, Yinghua Guzi, was an assassin who had met Wang Shuo once in the Dragon King's underground palace.

Although she had long seen that this was the army of Wana Town, she did not say anything to stop it. She wanted to kill Wang Shuo to avenge the day.

Although she got 100 dead spirit beads, it was not enough.

Yoshida Mondo made up his mind. Since he had killed 100 people in Wana Town, going to Wana Town to buy the dead spirit beads would be like walking into a trap. It would be better to go all out and destroy Wana Town directly.

He was very confident in his ninja troops.

After all, he wiped out the undead army that besieged him at a very small cost, including a silver boss with a level of 40.

In his eyes, Wana Town was just like that, nothing great.

This sneak attack on their 100-man team will definitely cause Wana Town to suffer a great loss of vitality.

At this time, they must have become frightened birds and dare not come out.

No, if they don't come out, they will have to attack the village and town by force, and the casualties will definitely increase.

It seems that we still have to think of a way to lure the snake out of the hole.

Just when Yoshida Mondo was thinking about it, a sound of footsteps interrupted his thinking.

"Lord Yoshida, there seems to be a team of cavalry outside the valley."
